question: What are the details of courses offered in the current academic term, including the academic year, term code, hgn code, the total number of types of courses, the average number of units, the department name, the name and email address of the person in charge?

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE course_offered AS
SELECT 
  academic_year,
  term_code,
  subject_id,
  subject_code,
  subject_number,
  subject_title,
  department_name,
  total_units AS total_units,
  hgn_code AS hgn_code
FROM beaver."course_catalog_subject_offered"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE terms AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT atp.term_code, atp.is_current_term
  FROM beaver."academic_term_parameter" atp
), add_year AS (
  SELECT b.term_code, COALESCE(CAST(at.academic_year AS BIGINT), NULL) AS academic_year, b.is_current_term
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN beaver."academic_terms" at
    ON at.term_code = b.term_code
)
SELECT term_code, academic_year, is_current_term
FROM add_year

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH current_offered AS (
  SELECT c.academic_year,
         c.term_code,
         c.hgn_code,
         c.subject_id,
         c.subject_code,
         c.subject_number,
         c.subject_title,
         c.department_name,
         c.total_units
  FROM course_offered c
  WHERE c.term_code = '2025FA'
), dept_contact AS (
  SELECT l.subject_id,
         l.term_code,
         l.offer_dept_name AS department_name,
         l.responsible_faculty_name AS person_in_charge_name,
         l.responsible_faculty_mit_id AS person_in_charge_email -- proxy; true email not available
  FROM library_subject_offered l
  WHERE l.term_code = '2025FA'
)
SELECT 
  co.academic_year,
  co.term_code,
  co.hgn_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.subject_id) AS total_number_of_types_of_courses,
  AVG(co.total_units) AS average_number_of_units,
  co.department_name,
  any_value(dc.person_in_charge_name) AS person_in_charge_name,
  any_value(dc.person_in_charge_email) AS person_in_charge_email
FROM current_offered co
LEFT JOIN dept_contact dc
  ON dc.term_code = co.term_code AND dc.subject_id = co.subject_id
GROUP BY co.academic_year, co.term_code, co.hgn_code, co.department_name
ORDER BY co.department_name, co.hgn_code
LIMIT 50
